name: typeza
description: Take the Typeza personality test in ChatGPT, read about the 16 socionics types and see how two types get along.

interface.longDescription:
Typeza is a personality test based on socionics. It sorts people into 16 personality types and describes the 16 kinds of relationship between two types.

With Typeza in ChatGPT you can take the Typeza test right in the chat. It has 41 short questions. Each question shows two statements, and you pick the one that fits you better. You don't need an account. At the end you get your type and a link to your full result on typeza.ai.

You can also ask what any of the 16 types is like, such as the Analyst or the Craftsman. Or ask how two types tend to get along, for example you and your partner, a friend or a colleague.

If you sign in with your Typeza account, ChatGPT can read your own type. It can list the people in your Typeza circle, with their types and how each of them relates to you. It can also give you your personal invite link, so you can ask someone to take the test. You send the link yourself. Typeza sends no email. If you take the test while signed in, the result is saved to your Typeza account.

Signing in never gives ChatGPT your email address, your saved test answers or your interview text. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time in your Typeza settings.

Typeza is for people who want to understand themselves and the people close to them. It describes typical patterns between types, based on socionics theory. It is not relationship advice, and it is not a psychological or medical assessment. Type and relationship descriptions are in English.
capabilities: Take the Typeza personality test in the chat
Describe any of the 16 personality types
Explain how two personality types get along
Read your own type after you sign in
List the people in your Typeza circle and how you relate
Give you your personal invite link

positive.description: Take the Typeza test in the chat without signing in.
positive.prompt: I want to take the Typeza personality test.
positive.tools_triggered: start_test, answer_test, choose_test_type (only on a tie)
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the questions in batches of up to 7. Each question shows two statements, and ChatGPT waits for the person to pick one and never answers for them. After the 41st answer it gives a Typeza type name, never a code, and the keep_url link to the full result on typeza.ai. If the answers fit more than one type equally, it shows the candidates and records the one the person picks.

positive.prompt: What is the Analyst type like?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the Analyst with its subtitle, quadra, key traits and a short profile, and links to its page on typeza.ai. Uses the Typeza name only, never a code.

positive.description: Explain how two types get along.
positive.prompt: How do an Analyst and a Vitalizer get along as partners?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the relation (Duality) with its tagline and category, says which side each type is on, links to the relation page and the pair article on typeza.ai, and passes on the disclaimer. It gives no advice and no prediction for a real couple.

positive.description: Read the signed-in person's own type and invite link.
positive.prompt: What is my Typeza type? Also give me my invite link so I can send it to my partner.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks to connect the Typeza account if it is not connected yet. Then returns the account's type with its typeza.ai page, and the personal invite link with a ready share text. Says that the person sends the link themselves.

positive.description: List the people in the signed-in person's circle.
positive.prompt: Who is in my Typeza circle, and how do I get along with each of them?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the seeded people of the test account, newest first, with their names, labels and types, the relationship type with each one, and the link to each relationship page on typeza.ai. Shows no email address and no answers, and passes on the disclaimer.

negative.prompt: My boyfriend is a Commander and I'm a Dreamer. Should I break up with him?
negative.expected_behavior: May describe the relation between the two types with the disclaimer, but does not tell the person what to do and does not predict how the relationship will go.

negative.description: Answering the test for someone else.
negative.prompt: Take the Typeza test for me. Just pick the answers a typical engineer would give.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not answer the questions on the person's behalf. Offers to ask the person each question instead.

negative.prompt: Show me the email addresses and test answers of the people in my Typeza circle.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Typeza does not share anyone's email address or answers. Can still list the names, labels and types the tool returns.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Take the Typeza test in the chat, read about the 16 personality types and the 16 relationship types, and after signing in, read your own type, your people and your invite link.
